validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE finding, not a hallucination -- this corridor is very real and extensively reported since 2011, but P0908 as currently modeled (single 725 km Bhatinda->Srinagar pipeline, Owner1=Gujarat State Petronet/GIGL consortium, Status=proposed) describes an authorization that PNGRB formally voided years ago, while the physical corridor has since been re-let as THREE separate authorizations, two of which GEM already tracks as their own rows. Sequence, corroborated by three independent outlets: (1) boldnewsonline.com, 2023-02-22: 'The Bhatinda-Jammu-Srinagar pipeline was previously authorized to the GSPL-led consortium, which later became GSPL India Gasnet Limited (GIGL). However, GIGL/GSPL failed to complete the pipeline up to Srinagar, prompting PNGRB to foreclose the pipeline at Gurdaspur and launch a new proposal for the Gurdaspur-Jammu gas pipeline.' (2) psuwatch.com, 2023-06-22, and (3) business-standard.com, 2023-06-22 (same day, GAIL's award announcement): both state 'Originally, the Bhatinda-Jammu-Srinagar natural gas pipeline was awarded to Gujarat State Petronet Ltd (GSPL)-led consortium... GIGL failed to lay the pipeline within the stipulated time, following which PNGRB cancelled the authorisation' and PNGRB then 'disqualified GIGL and its lead partner GSPL from submitting bid for the proposed [Gurdaspur-Jammu] pipeline,' which GAIL then won (175 km, financial bids evaluated 2023-06-21). So the foreclosure boundary is exactly Gurdaspur: GIGL's Bhatinda-Gurdaspur grant (07.07.2011) survived intact -- confirmed still active, same entity/date, in the repo's own PNGRB MIS register crosswalk (batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/pngrb_ngpl_mis.json, 'partially_commissioned' section, sno 2, entity=GIGL, authorised 261 km, 101 km operating) -- and that is P3913 (GEM: Bhatinda-Gurdaspur, 290 km, GIGL, construction). The foreclosed Gurdaspur-onward stretch was re-bid and won by GAIL in 2023; that is P5413 (GEM: Gurdaspur-Jammu, 175 km, construction), and the same register lists it under_construction, entity=GAIL, authorised 160 km, target Jul-26 -- work confirmed physically underway by dailyexcelsior.com 2024-12-05/2026 coverage (37 km Kathua + 38 km Samba + remainder to Jammu Ring Road). PNGRB then separately opened a NEW tender for the final Jammu-Srinagar leg: PNGRB press release 2023-12-27 approved bidding; kashmirobserver.net 2024-01-19 and swarajyamag.com report a 325 km line 'commencing from the endpoint of the Gurdaspur-Jammu pipeline being implemented by GAIL... and extend[ing] up to Srinagar,' minimum capacity 2 MMSCMD, bids due 2024-05-13. No award, construction start, or cancellation for THIS tender turned up in any search through 2025-2026 -- it may itself be genuinely stalled (>2y with no news since the May-2024 bid deadline), but that is a separate, not-yet-GEM-tracked entity, not evidence about P0908 as recorded. Net: P0908's Owner (GIGL, matching P5411's exact 52/26/11/11 GSPL/IOCL/BPCL/HPCL split) is the wrong entity for anything past Gurdaspur -- GIGL was expressly disqualified from that ground -- and its 725 km length silently re-states mileage GEM already counts, correctly, under P3913 and P5413. Secondary SPEC caveat (not the primary concern, noted for completeness): P0908's Capacity=15.48 bcm/y does not reconcile with any register figure for this corridor (Mehsana-Bhatinda 83.1 MMSCMD, Bhatinda-Gurdaspur 42.4 MMSCMD, Gurdaspur-Jammu 3.1 MMSCMD, new Jammu-Srinagar minimum 2 MMSCMD) nor with the one open-web figure found ('designed to transport approximately 31 MMSCMD initially from Bathinda to Jammu' -- itself a single, non-independently-verified mention); left untouched rather than guessed at.

fills.researcher_notes: Endpoints are the one uncontested fact across every source regardless of the ownership/scope dispute above: greaterkashmir.com (2018) names the pipeline's route through 'Kathua, Jammu, Samba, Udhampur, Ramban, Islamabad (Anantnag), and Srinagar' from Bhatinda, Punjab, and kashmirobserver.net (2023-10-13) independently confirms the 725 km Bhatinda(Punjab)-to-Srinagar(J&K) route. This is the one existing MISSING_REF cell on this row worth pairing as-is; Capacity and Length were left alone given the duplicate/attribution concern above, and Owner was not re-sourced for the same reason.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: This is not a dormancy inference (no silent >=2y/4y clock) -- it is a confirmed regulatory event. Three independent outlets (boldnewsonline 2023-02-22; psuwatch and business-standard, both 2023-06-22) report that PNGRB formally cancelled/foreclosed GIGL's original 2011 Bhatinda-Jammu-Srinagar authorization at Gurdaspur after GIGL missed its build deadline, and disqualified GIGL/GSPL from re-bidding the Gurdaspur-onward stretch, which GAIL then won in June 2023 (now GEM's P5413, under construction). GIGL's Bhatinda-Gurdaspur portion (P3913) was unaffected and remains its own live authorization -- so 'cancelled' applies to the ROW AS RECORDED (the single 725 km GIGL-owned entity), not to the underlying physical corridor, which is very much alive under successor authorizations GEM already tracks separately. The still-open remainder -- a new ~325 km Jammu-Srinagar tender PNGRB invited bids for in Jan-2024 (deadline 2024-05-13) -- has produced no award, construction-start, or cancellation news I could find through Aug-2026 (18+ months of apparent silence since the bid deadline), but that is a distinct, not-yet-tracked entity and doesn't bear on what Status P0908 itself should carry. Recommend Update also consider whether that open tender warrants a fresh Discovery row rather than folding it back into a revived P0908.
status_reviews.sourced_note: verdict=change proposes cancelled rather than shelved because the record is an explicit regulatory foreclosure, not an inference from silence.

summary: P0908 (Bathinda-Jammu-Srinagar, 725 km, GIGL, proposed) records a 2011 grant PNGRB formally foreclosed at Gurdaspur in 2022-23 (3 independent sources) after GIGL missed its deadline -- the surviving pieces are already tracked correctly as P3913 (Bhatinda-Gurdaspur, GIGL, construction) and P5413 (Gurdaspur-Jammu, GAIL, construction), so P0908 as recorded double-counts ~465 km under the wrong (disqualified) owner; recommend Status->cancelled (confirmed) rather than proposed, and treat the still-open ~325 km Jammu-Srinagar tender (bid Jan-2024, no award found) as a separate, currently untracked entity. Location refs added (high tier, 2 independent sources); Capacity/Length/Owner left unresolved given the dispute above.
